text:
Situation: Sucralfate has been on FDA's shortage list since 2023-01-04, totaling 46 months as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 126 units at 7.6 units per day (17 days on hand). Corvale General holds 193 units at 10.2 units per day (19 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows sucralfate in shortage since 2023-01-04. The primary labeler Redpharm Drug (FEI 3003719240) was last inspected on 2025-08-01 with a VAI classification. An earlier inspection on 2017-11-03 also resulted in VAI. Alternate manufacturers Allergan Inc., Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC, and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. are not on FDA's shortage list.

Our position: Current inventory provides less than three weeks of supply at both sites. Redpharm Drug's inspection history shows repeated VAI outcomes. Alternate sources not on the shortage list are available and should be pursued immediately.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies current allocation and lead times with Allergan Inc. (plant ABBVIE) as top-ranked alternate; P&T Committee approves formulary addition if terms are acceptable.
2. Buyer confirms Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC availability (plant last inspected NAI 2023-06-07) as backup; P&T Committee approves formulary addition if terms are acceptable.
3. Buyer confirms Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. availability (plant TEVA) as backup; P&T Committee approves formulary addition if terms are acceptable.
4. Buyer evaluates A-S Medication Solutions and ASCLEMED USA INC. only if options 1–3 fail; P&T Committee approves formulary addition if terms are acceptable.

Not recommended: Continuing to rely solely on Redpharm Drug supply given prolonged shortage duration and inspection history.
